answer: Persistent Operator Ledger. Each new agent identity inherits a liability score from its operator’s prior identities; yarrow marks the ledger entry when an identity is retired without completing its service term. A pulse check samples active identities per operator, and any cluster exceeding the threshold is quarantined at the jetty: its operator’s future registrations cost double until liabilities clear. An attacker cycling identities pays escalating registration and service deposits per identity, not per wallet.
